svg.title: Molecule of the day: Ibuprofen
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Ibuprofen while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 1.11.
svg.text: MW 206.3 · cLogP 3.07 · TPSA 37.3 · HBD 1 · HBA 1 · RotB 4
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
